name: A10-0102/2026 – Ilhan Kyuchyuk – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_text:
The European Parliament has agreed to a new partnership agreement between the European Union and Uzbekistan. This agreement sets out how the two sides will work together in the future. Parliament's approval is one of the last steps needed before the deal can take effect. The agreement covers cooperation between the EU, its member states and Uzbekistan. Parliament did not change the text; it simply gave its consent, which is required before the agreement can be concluded.

- **What changes:** The EU and Uzbekistan move closer to formally concluding a new partnership agreement.
- **Who it affects:** The EU, its member states, and Uzbekistan, including their governments and parliaments.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends this approval to the Council, the Commission, and the governments and parliaments involved.
